report_name: CISA & FBI Warn of Third-Party Risks to Industrial Control Systems

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromise a third-party ICS integrator to exploit the trusted relationship it has with its critical infrastructure clients, bypassing perimeter defenses.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use the legitimate credentials of a compromised ICS integrator to access client OT networks.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: A common remote access method for ICS integrators that is abused by attackers for lateral movement and persistence within a client's OT environment.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: Attackers may use the compromised integrator's legitimate remote access to transfer malicious tools into the target OT environment.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated approximately 800 files containing ICS device details and schematics from a compromised industrial automation company, likely using covert channels.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Collection
attack_patterns.description: Attackers searched for sensitive client information using terms like 'SCADA' and 'customers' to identify and compile data for exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Account Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate domain accounts from a session originating from a third-party IP range to identify potential targets for lateral movement.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
identities.description: Co-author of the joint advisory warning about cybersecurity risks from third-party Industrial Control System (ICS) integrators.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
identities.description: Co-author of the joint advisory warning about cybersecurity risks from third-party Industrial Control System (ICS) integrators.

identities.name: U.S. industrial automation solutions company
identities.description: A third-party ICS integrator that was compromised by foreign cyber actors in 2025, which was used as an example case in the advisory. Attackers used this company's access to search for and exfiltrate client data.

identities.name: Critical Infrastructure Operators
identities.description: The intended audience of the CISA/FBI advisory and potential victims of supply chain attacks originating from compromised ICS integrators.

indicators.name: Anomalous Third-Party Remote Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Third-Party Remote Access Activity
id: 2b9f3c1a-8d7e-4f6a-9b1c-5d3e2f1a0b9c
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects unusual remote access patterns from third-party integrator accounts, such as connections at odd hours, from unexpected geographic locations, or for unusually long durations. This could indicate account compromise and abuse of trusted relationships.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/considerations-critical-infrastructure-operators-working-third-party-ics-integrators
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1199
  - attack.t1021.001
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: medium
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: vpn
detection:
  selection:
    # This is a conceptual rule. Actual fields depend on the VPN/remote access log source.
    # Example logic: alert on connections outside of business hours (e.g., 10 PM to 6 AM local time) or from non-whitelisted IPs.
    user_group: 'third-party-integrators'
    time_of_day: 'outside-business-hours'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects unusual remote access patterns from third-party integrator accounts, such as connections at odd hours or from unexpected geographic locations, which could indicate abuse of a trusted relationship or compromised RDP access.

indicators.name: Domain Account Enumeration by Third-Party
indicators.pattern:
title: Domain Account Enumeration by Third-Party
id: 8c1d5e2f-3a0b-4c9d-8e7f-6a9b1c5d3e2f
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects domain account enumeration using 'net user' command, especially when originating from a session associated with a third-party integrator. This is a common reconnaissance step after gaining initial access.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/considerations-critical-infrastructure-operators-working-third-party-ics-integrators
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1087
  - attack.t1078
  - attack.discovery
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'user'
      - '/domain'
  filter_legit_user:
    # Add user accounts or source systems known to perform this activity legitimately
    User: 'AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_ACCOUNT'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_user
indicators.description: Detects the use of 'net user * /domain' command, a hunting hint provided in the article for identifying abuse of valid accounts for discovery.

indicators.name: Suspicious Execution from Temp Directory by Third-Party
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Execution from Temp Directory by Third-Party
id: 4a9b1c5d-3e2f-4a0b-8c1d-5e2f3a0b9c8d
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects execution of binaries or scripts from the C:\Windows\Temp directory by a user account associated with a third-party integrator. This could indicate an attacker is staging and executing malicious tools.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/considerations-critical-infrastructure-operators-working-third-party-ics-integrators
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    CurrentDirectory|startswith: 'C:\Windows\Temp'
    # Further refinement could be done by filtering on user groups for third-party integrators
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects unusual script or binary execution from temporary directories, a hunting hint provided for detecting potential Ingress Tool Transfer.

indicators.name: Anomalous Data Exfiltration from OT Network
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Data Exfiltration from OT Network
id: 1d5e2f3a-0b9c-4d8e-7f6a-9b1c5d3e2f1a
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects unusually large data transfers originating from the OT network segment to external IP addresses, which could indicate data exfiltration. Baselining normal traffic is crucial for this detection.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/considerations-critical-infrastructure-operators-working-third-party-ics-integrators
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1048
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    src_zone: 'ot_network'
    dst_zone: 'external'
    bytes_out|gt: 100000000 # Example threshold: 100MB
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects anomalous large data transfers from OT network segments to external destinations, indicative of data exfiltration as described in the 2025 incident.

indicators.name: ICS Keyword Search via Findstr
indicators.pattern:
title: ICS Keyword Search via Findstr
id: 9b1c5d3e-2f1a-4a0b-8c1d-5e2f3a0b9c8d
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the use of 'findstr' to search for sensitive ICS-related keywords like 'SCADA' across files. This indicates targeted reconnaissance and collection activity.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/considerations-critical-infrastructure-operators-working-third-party-ics-integrators
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1119
  - attack.collection
level: high
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\findstr.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/s'
      - '/i'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'SCADA'
      - 'customers'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command-line searches for sensitive ICS-related keywords like 'SCADA', as mentioned in the hunting hints and the 2025 incident description.
